ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, we have $AB=AC$ and $AD$ is the median to side $BC$. Point $E$ is on side $AB$, and $DE \parallel AC$. If $DE=3$, what is the value of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB=AC$, and $AD$ is the median to side $BC$,\\
hence $\angle EAD=\angle CAD$, $\angle B=\angle C$,\\
Given $DE\parallel AC$,\\
hence $\angle EDA=\angle CAD$, $\angle EDB=\angle C$,\\
thus $\angle EAD=\angle EDA$, $\angle EDB=\angle B$,\\
hence $DE=AE$, $DE=BE$,\\
thus $AB=2DE=\boxed{6}$.
